sc: Ancient Legionary Armour is a cosmetic override outfit that can be purchased for 1 premier reward token from the Premier Token Store.
It could originally be unlocked through Prime Gaming as part of an offer from 14 April to 12 May 2020.
Ancient pages are items which are sometimes obtained when rummaging barbarian skeletons or as monster drops in the Ancient Cavern.
Duplicate pages may still be obtained before completion of My notes if rummaging skeletons.
Ancient scales are mainly dropped by Seiryu the Azure Serpent in the Temple of Aminishi.
A quantity of scales are also received from opening an elite chest, which is received as a drop from The Ambassador in The Shadow Reef if all three Elite Dungeons are completed in order.
Annihilation is a degradable tier 87 two-handed melee weapon, available as a reward from Slayer as a possible drop from a Wilderness slayer chest.
It can be traded again after being fully repaired.
It can only be obtained and used while training Dungeoneering.
It can be created at level 68 Smithing from four argonite bars.

The Third Age-dyed augmented sirenic hauberk is level 90 Ranged torso slot power armour, created by using an augmentor and divine charges on a sirenic hauberk (third age), or by using third age dye on an augmented sirenic hauberk.
It can be made by taking a Pirate bandana (blue) and an Eye patch to Patchy on Mos Le'Harmless and paying him 500 coins to sew them together.
The Bandana and eyepatch can also be found on the shore of some uncharted islands.
A bird's nest is an item that can be received from Woodcutting after having built a tier 3 Grove near Fort Forinthry.

Because the bird's nests with Imcando fragments can only be obtained after having unlocked all benefits of the Grove, this type of bird's nest will always be placed in a player's backpack, or in a wood box if a player is carrying one.

Blue dragonhide gold-trimmed set.x: Blue dragonhide gold-trimmed set is an item obtained by exchanging a set of items with a Grand Exchange clerk via their right-click "Exchange" option, followed by the "Sets" tab and clicking on the appropriate item set within the Item Sets interface.

tx:
Upon purchasing the bonecrusher, it will not destroy any bones until the player has selected their settings. This can be done by left-clicking the bonecrusher and choosing what bones will be crushed. Currently, bones and burnt bones are both toggled by the Bones option.
The item needs only to be present in the player's inventory, worn in the pocket slot, or in the slayer belt for it to take effect, and may be found useful if players have a tendency to leave bones on the ground and not bury them. When a monster is killed that drops a selected bone while the bonecrusher is carried, Prayer experience is rewarded in a way similar to Slayer experience (with bones missing from the drops), with no animation or anything similar occurring. This means that this item won't slow players down at all compared to leaving bones on the ground. The bonecrusher has no effect on drops when it is left in the bank and will not work if LootShare or CoinShare is active, or in PvP activities.
The bonecrusher can be added to the slayer belt by learning how to from a Slayer master at a cost of 500 Slayer points. Once on the slayer belt it cannot be removed, however the settings menu can still be accessed via the tool belt.
If a monster drops more than one bone, such as bloodveld or jogres often do, all dropped bones that are selected to be crushed will be converted to prayer experience; the rest will appear on the ground as usual, as a separate drop. Also, long or curved bones will not be buried by the bonecrusher, as these are a separate drop too.
Bones dropped as notes, like those dropped by cyclopes in the Warriors' Guild when using multi-token mode, are not affected by the bonecrusher.…
sc: The bonecrusher is a reward bought from Daemonheim Rewards.

When a player has a bonecrusher present in their pocket slot, backpack, or tool belt, all bones defined by the bonecrusher's settings dropped by monster kills, or obtained from Hunter, will be automatically converted into Prayer experience.

An unfinished masterwork ranged draft for the vambraces must first be created at the pattern table, consuming all of the items, after which it can be worked on via the tailoring process to create it. Crafting this item requires a total of 25,000 progress; 7,500 at the drafting table (as an unfinished masterwork ranged draft) and 17,500 at the tailor's dummy (as an unfinished masterwork ranged vambraces). At the default rate of 20 progress every 4 ticks (2.4 seconds), this takes 5000 ticks, or 50 minutes. This time may be increased or decreased by interacting with focus windows.

A cadavaberry parasol is a parasol that could be won from the Build A Beach Treasure Hunter promotion.

The cave crawler skin is a quest item obtained by killing a cave crawler during the Fur 'n Seek quest.
The player must prepare the hide using a bag of salt to obtain a scrubbed cave crawler skin.
As with all Tier 11 items, players cannot make this armour and it is only available as a drop from the boss Astea Frostweb.
It is obtained by killing one of three knights--Ranalph Devere, Irvig Senay or San Tojalon—in the dungeon under Kharazi Jungle.
When combined with the lump of crystal, and the hunk of crystal (obtained by killing the other two knights), they form the heart crystal required to unlock a door leading further into the dungeon.

Between 63 and 75, this is one of the highest experience pouches that can be produced from crimson charms.
Special teak logs are items that can be obtained while chopping down teak trees (even on free-to-play worlds, despite being a members item).
They are obtained instead of the normal teak logs roughly 2% of the time, yielding the same amount of Woodcutting experience as normal teak logs when chopped.
They can also be obtained by opening sedimentary and igneous geodes.
Until September 2009, spirit shards were a "junk" item, that were rarely bought for 25 coins each.
